name: P2 Knowledge Base Development
postCreateCommand: sudo rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libleptonica6 libtesseract5 && LIBDIR=/usr/lib/$(dpkg-architecture -qDEB_HOST_MULTIARCH) && sudo ln -sf $LIBDIR/libleptonica.so.6 $LIBDIR/liblept.so.5 && sudo ldconfig || true; sudo mkdir -p /Users/stephen && sudo ln -sfn /opt/container-tools /Users/stephen/container-tools; pip install --user PyYAML || true; cd /tmp && unzip -o /workspaces/P2-Knowledge-Base/.devcontainer/pnut-ts-linux-arm64-015500.zip && sudo cp /tmp/pnut-ts-linux-arm64-015500/pnut_ts/pnut-ts /usr/local/bin/pnut-ts && sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/pnut-ts && rm -rf /tmp/pnut-ts-linux-arm64-015500 || true; npm install -g @openai/codex || true; test -f /tmp/devcontainer-bin/bash_aliases && cp /tmp/devcontainer-bin/bash_aliases ~/.bash_aliases || true; curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash || true; grep -q '$HOME/.local/bin' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || echo 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"' >> ~/.bashrc; export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; claude --update || true;
